correctness.rationale: An exact four-normal zonotope description and unimodular symmetry reduce all real parameters to a one-variable case. The upper bound is proved by concavity of horizontal slice width, two explicit threshold rows, and exact overlap inequalities; lower bounds use a disappearing row for the first branch and an exact half-integer-height lattice hole for the second branch. Both branches cross at 7/24, so the complete sharp profile and extrema follow. The exact-rational verifier checks algebra and rational samples, but is not treated as a proof of infinitely many parameter values.
